reason: Log-x curvature through 1e-6 failed to lift the nearly linear x=0.001 extrapolation mode. Test the minimum direct first-derivative energy of FNP with respect to log(x), while retaining the weakest b-direction strength that stabilized the requested x=0.1 region.

objective_family.logx_definition: mean squared first derivative of FNP with respect to log(x), scaled by the fixed diagnostic log-x interval and evaluated over bT=0.1..3

selection.rule: Select the weakest x-slope strength satisfying every gate for all common sources; never select by final band width.
selection.uncertainty_semantics: Experimental replicas are a conditional 68% interval; residual local-start/model spread is separately reported.
